items.name: Cottbus Cubing 2025
items.information: ### Deutsch Herzlich willkommen zur Cottbuser Cubing Competition! Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur ersten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Vom 15. bis 16. November 2025 dreht sich in Cottbus alles um Würfel, Zeiten und jede Menge Spaß. Diese Premiere ist nicht nur ein sportliches Event, sondern auch ein Schritt, die Cubing-Community in Brandenburg weiter wachsen zu lassen. Wir sind stolz, mit euch gemeinsam Cubing-Geschichte in der Lausitz zu schreiben. Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln! [Event-Trailer](https://youtube.com/shorts/Va4iRMysVpQ?si=ID4au8HW_QbFkCFX) **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** ### English Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition! We’re very excited to welcome you all to the first official speedcubing competition in the Lausitz region! From November 15 to 16, 2025, everything in Cottbus will revolve around cubes, times, and a whole lot of fun.This premiere is not just a sporting event, but also a milestone in helping the cubing community grow here in Brandenburg. We’re proud to be making cubing history in the Lausitz together with you. We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes! [Event-Trailer](https://youtube.com/shorts/Va4iRMysVpQ?si=ID4au8HW_QbFkCFX) **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEzOTkxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--afaa0c7e07a9256263f11b2588651c4929c99f85/Logo_Web.png)

items.name: Pre-Nationals Warm-Up Athens 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyMDcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4efe096657d5e0709c184fa20b7d53a5857ba9a7/551543473_726119743805711_8970889758942482893_n.jpg) Το τρίτο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα πλησιάζει και αυτός θα είναι ο τελευταίος διαγωνισμός πριν την διεξαγωγή του. Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο, θα συναντηθούμε ξανά πριν ταξιδέψουμε βόρεια για το μεγάλο speedcubing φινάλε του 2025 . Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The 3rd national championship (Greek Nationals 2025) is approaching, and this will be the last competition before the big event! In the conference hall of KYBE cultural centre of Peristeri, for two days, experienced and new comers, young and older cubers from all over the country — and beyond — will meet once again before we head north for the grand speedcubing finale of 2025. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another celebration of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Autumn 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Jeremia Neuhold, Julian Ostdal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Autumn 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Jeremia Neuhold, Julian Ostadal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Bergen Fall 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Bergen Fall. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### Nye Deltakere Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2025#63474-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to to Bergen Fall! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete. ### New Competitors There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2025#63474-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ## 충청북도에서 열리는 첫 WCA 대회! WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OkcheonAutumnBreeze2025#64080-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OkcheonAutumnBreeze2025#64079-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## First WCA competition in Chungcheongbuk-do! If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OkcheonAutumnBreeze2025#64080-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OkcheonAutumnBreeze2025#64079-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Wednesday October 8th, 2025 at 10 pm (10 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mercredi 8 octobre 2025 à 22h (10 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. items.name: Volos Wild Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIwODI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be406f2472acbf959e21897f27b9bdc0460b0ad7/536296154_1486549299105261_4236201959451164819_n.jpg) Το Volos Wild Open 2025 θα είναι ο διαγωνισμός με τα περισσότερα events στην Ελλάδα για το 2025 μέχρι στιγμής και ο πρώτος που θα γίνει ποτέ στην πόλη του Βόλου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του VALIS HOTEL για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) Volos Wild Open 2025 will be the competition with the most events in Greece for 2025 so far, and the very first ever held in Volos! In the conference hall of VALIS HOTEL, for 2 days, old and new, young and older Cubers from all over the country – and beyond – will meet again for our favorite hobby. Bring your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come join us for yet another celebration of cubing! Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, both steps are required: 1. Completing the registration on the competition’s WCA page **AND** 2. Paying the registration fee with your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Graz Open 2025
items.information: ##### *English version is below* ​ #### **Deutsch:** ​ Speedcubing ist auch 2025 wieder zurück in Graz! Wir freuen uns wieder ein offizielles WCA Turnier in Graz zu veranstalten. ​ Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. ​ Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! ​ Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. ​ ​ Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ​ ----- ​ #### **English:** ​ Speedcubing is back in Graz! We are happy to announce another WCA Competition in Graz. ​ The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. ​ The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. ​ Every Competitor can bring one guest.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$30. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$30. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2025
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbzU1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2bf71d7090c7cef300fb39fb94a81e1b8389c08d/Page%202.png) Cube Together je sice soutěž, hlavně to však má být také setkání všech nadšenců Rubikových kostek bez ohledu na věk, schopnosti a ostatní zájmy atd., prostě pro všechny 😊 Pokud máte doma nějaké kostky, co už moc nepoužíváte a chtěli byste je poslat dále (prodat), na soutěži bude po celou dobu soutěže pro toto prostor 😉! items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2025. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.name: CF Goes Crazy Brzeziny 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MDU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9099699a415c4020c460b8848aaf69949ce677ba/goes%20crazy%20wca.png) Drodzy, ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na jedyne w swoim rodzaju zawody side'owe! Chcemy dać Wam możliwość sprawdzenia swoich sił w konkurencjach blindowych oraz Big Cube'ach bez ciążącego na Was widma restrykcyjnych cut-offów, które zastąpione zostały wysokimi limitami kumulowanymi. Dzięki temu mniej zaawansowani zawodnicy będą mieli szansę na uzyskanie wyników których wcześniej nie byli w stanie osiągnąć! Oszaleliśmy? Być może 😉 Dear All, Cube Factory Team invites you to a unique side-events competition! We want to give you a chance to try your luck in big cubes and blinfolded events, without the strict cut-offs looming over you. Instead, we have replaced them with very generous cumulative time limits. This way, less experienced competitors will finally have a shot at achieving results that used to be out of reach! Have we Gone Crazy? Maybe 😉 ---- **WAŻNE / IMPORTANT** Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2) regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia. Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 4x4x4 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 5x5x5 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. 3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 4x4x4 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 5x5x5 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16.

Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMTc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2f863d51aca44602df4916ae5a0e5ef1e278b5af/GO%202025.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**! **English** **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik’s Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**!

items.information: 🇧🇷 Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: ​ - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IICapixabaChallenge2025/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IICapixabaChallenge/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Linz Summer 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTY1NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--706ac75f6cf6972bc1df69e20afd1af3fd228aca/Todo%20o%20nada%20San%20Andr%C3%A9s%20Cholula%202025_500.png) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, sus 37 iglesias y sus aires prehispánicos están listos para recibirte en esta nueva competencia. Tendrás una sola ronda para demostrar por que eres el mejor. Cada segundo y resolución será decisiva desde el primer intento. ¿Tienes lo que se necesita para ser el más rápido? ¡Acepta el reto y gira hacia la victoria! Esto es, **¡Todo o Nada!** Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Municipo de **"San Andrés Cholula"** y a la Presidenta Municipal **Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 20215 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, with its 37 churches and pre-Hispanic spirit, is ready to welcome you to this new competition. You’ll have just one round to prove why you’re the best. Every second and every solve will be decisive from the very first attempt. Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Take the challenge and twist your way to victory! This is All or Nothing! This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the Municipality of **San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres.** Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2025! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTcxOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b0423464106a5bf4730ca8189b9c1cd1a18f9149/Oslo%20Open%202025.PNG)

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 30 mai 2025 à 20h.** Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday May 30th, 2025 at 8 pm.** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- ## English Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](link da página de inscrições da sua competição) tab. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Saint-Augustin B 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos o primeiro Tatu Open Curitiba! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça o regulamento, que pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. Inscrições na hora do evento serão aceitas somente para a modalidade 3x3x3 É importante chegar pelo menos meia hora antes das categorias que for participar para relizar o check in. Lembrando que se for sua primeira competição, você irá precisar levar um documento com foto. **English** It is with great joy that we announce the first Tatu Open Curitiba! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner (first competition)', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event. Registrations during the competition will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 event. It is important to arrive half an hour before the events you'll participate in to do the check-in. Also remember that if this is your first competition, you'll need to bring a photo ID.

items.name: Kölner Kubing 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDIwOTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7a09c07e7df2145faa8d4f7db972b8360df44444/KK25_New.png) ##### **German** Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events! **Wichtig!** Bei den letzten Competitions von Köln hatten wir in den ersten 5 Minuten über 150 Anmeldungen. Sorgt bitte dafür, dass ihr die Teilnahmegebühr **vor** der Online-Anmeldung bezahlt. Wenn Ihr überweisen müsst, macht das bitte 2-3 Tage vorher, damit die Zahlung rechtzeitig bei uns ankommt. Wir gehen wieder davon aus, dass auch Kölner Kubing 2025 innerhalb weniger Minuten voll sein wird! **English** Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event! **Important!** In the last competitions in Cologne we had over 150 registrations in the first 5 minutes. Please make sure that you pay the entry fee **before** you register online. If you have to pay by bank transfer, please do so 2-3 days in advance so that we receive the payment in time. We assume that Kölner Kubing 2025 will again be full within a few minutes!

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Taxas de inscrição não serão devolvidas em nenhuma circunstância. - Não serão aceitas inscrições no local. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Registration fees will not be refunded under any circumstances. - On-site registrations will not be accepted. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: German Open 2025
items.information: In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2025 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun! Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2025 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2025
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

items.name: Peristeri Spring Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxNDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3bff12c8b9b6016985d4932977574e412605ceb3/486747483_24056017737321961_6930283358538797018_n.jpg) Το Peristeri Spring Open 2025 θα είναι o τρίτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στον Δήμο Περιστερίου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Peristeri Spring Open 2025 will be Greece’s third official competition of 2025 and the first ever to be held in the Municipality of Peristeri! For two days, in the conference hall of KYVE Peristeriou, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Hessen Open 2025 is open to every citizen from every nation. Hessen Open 2025 is a two-day competition and series competition to Hessen Mini Open 2025, which will be held at the same weekend, on friday. Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzQ0MzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5f765ba47cfdb6bb1045e4365d1173a5cf2989e5/RCO%202025%20(h_bg_white).jpg) ### PORTUGUÊS ### Sejam bem-vindos ao Rio Cubolympics 2025! Será um prazer recebê-los. **VEJA AS ATUALIZAÇÕES DA COMPETIÇÃO NO NOSSO INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH ### Welcome to Rio Cubolympics 2025! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **SEE THE UPDATES OF THE COMPETITIONS ON OUR INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.name: Beginner Big Cubes Ohio 2025
items.information: This competition takes place on a **Friday Evening** and features only big cubes (4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, and 7x7x7 Cube), and is for beginners or those who normally aren't able to compete in these cubes at other competitions. However, this competition might not be recommended for first-time competitors as it does not include the normal 3x3x3 Cube. For those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest or carpooling as spectator seating and parking spaces will be limited. All competitors will be expected to help out in the group they are not competing in.

You must choose at most one of the two. If you put both, your registration will not be accepted. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Longmont for another day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 110 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 PM UTC 04-14-2025) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

The first ever state championship held in Nevada! The competition is open to all, but only Nevada residents are eligible for state champion titles. See NV Champion Eligibility for more info. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** ** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** ** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: **PORTUGUÊS** Sejam todos bem-vindos à segunda competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara! Essa competição terá como foco os "big cubes", portanto teremos tempos de corte generosos para que todos possam participar e se divertir. Também teremos premiação extra-oficial para as mulheres e os iniciantes melhores colocados na modalidade 3x3x3. Nesta competição estamos arrecadando doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba Campanha Beneficente. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Lembre-se de estar **pelo menos meia hora antes** de cada rodada que for participar e de fazer seu credenciamento no momento que chegar! **ENGLISH** Welcome to the second competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara! This competition is going to have a focus on "big cubes", so we will have generous cutoff times so everyone can participate and have fun. We will also have unofficial awards to the best women and newcomers in the 3x3x3 event. In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the Charitable Campaign tab. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Remember to be at the venue at least **thirty minutes before** each event you will participate and to check in at the moment you arrive!

items.name: Baguio Speedcubing Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjcxNzksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--091213fa1a72ff7952077719fa5e390544436ae6/newcomer.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzE4NjYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--a2ee37bdd1667ca0dcf6da6b7321d336cb9ad2ee/Baguio%20SO.png) This is the 8th installment of WCA Rubik's Cube Competition in Baguio City! This time, the competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: ● 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. ● Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. ● If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. ● If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. # **REGISTRATION** The registration fee is good for **ALL EVENTS/PUZZLES** of your choice. Early registration is from February 15 to March 25 at Php 250.00 for Kiddie Division (4-11 years old) and Php 350.00 for Open Division. Late registration is from March 26 to 29 (before 3x3x3 R1 starts) at Php 350.00 (Kiddie Division) and Php 450.00 for Open Division. To register, use the WCA website and follow the payment details **if you are a returning competitor**. **If you are a newcomer**, please contact Xavier De Vera at 09461564040 for the details. Payment Method: Slots are secured via payment-first system. You may pay for your registration fees via: **GCash Express Send** Account Name: Xavier De Vera Account Number: 0946 156 4040 ** PLEASE indicate the NAME OF THE COMPETITOR in message/note tab in GCash app before sending payment. You can also send the proof of payment to xprestousa.27@gmail.com. Failing to do so might revoke your registration.

items.information: Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ​ ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2025 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: CubeCo Coastal Cubing KZN 2025
items.information: **Durban’s First 2-Day Cubing Competition in Over Two Years!** Join us for an action-packed weekend of speedcubing on March 21st & 22nd! Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance. Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you. New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too! Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!
